heuristic_findings.rule: Possible Primitive Obsession (code-review smell baseline; judgment call)
heuristic_findings.finding: Durable actor binding identity, readiness and recovery state travel as a mutable serde_json::Value; configure_thread mutates string keys and constructs another string state at line 1229. Missing fields silently become Null, making partial-state review difficult.
heuristic_findings.recommendation: Consider typed binding identity and lifecycle records, keeping native wire payloads as JSON. This is a maintainability suggestion, not a documented-standard violation or a requirement for this phase.

qualification_limits: Source/evidence review only; no new tests, builds, services, model calls, cleanup or source edits.
Retained MODEL_FREE_ACTUAL_PROTOCOL evidence is environment-specific; final source pins do not establish contemporaneous whole-tree identity for every historical RED.
Root fresh gate, Spec axis, independent branch review and human acceptance remain separate. Downstream lead delivery, scoped TUI, private Git, credentials and live inference are outside this phase.
cross_axis_handoff: Sent coordinator the source-derived native supervisor restart schema collision at supervisor.rs:323-335 and :544-548 for behavioral disposition; it is fail-closed and is not classified as a hard Standards breach.
